pin_added.question: What is a single-pipeline rerun, in the model? A PipelineRun carries a full settings snapshot and emits Signals — re-scoring only sentiment produces something that is not one of those.
Five identical-looking checkboxes with five very different consequences. Should the screen say what each one costs?
This button silently changes what every analyst is looking at. Does anything tell them?

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
One row per source. Unchecking takes it out of the **next** run.

What the checklist does not say: the five rows are not equivalent. One of them is not fetched at all, one of them is ours, and one of them costs two scorers.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip: Off = fundamentals lose their price denominators, technical signals lose everything. Technicals do not survive this one.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip: Off = three of the four scorers are affected: sentiment loses filing tone, fundamentals lose their line items, insider-cluster loses everything. The widest blast radius on this list.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip: Off = **two** scorers, not one. Sentiment goes entirely, and the momentum read inside technical signals loses its way of telling a breakout from a knee-jerk.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip: Off = no position sizing, no exposure, no P&L. This is not a degraded run, it is a different product — and it is the only checkbox on the list that would do that.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip: Off = the aggregator loses Fed dates and CPI prints. Nothing upstream notices, because this source never passes the Cutoff or touches enrichment.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
Drawn as an ordinary editable field, because that is what it is — nobody has *chosen* to make it read-only, they have just never touched it.

Note it says 06:00, which is when scoring starts. The 05:30 fetch and the 05:45 cutoff are not on this screen at all, and they are the times that actually decide whether a run is any good.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip: 1-day 95% VaR. Crossing it fires a Risk Alert, which surfaces on the dashboard the same day.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
A **gate**, not a label. Below this, a Signal exists internally and reaches nothing a client sees.

So dragging this leftward does not dim anything — it publishes signals that were previously invisible.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
Nothing is overwritten — a new PipelineRun is created beside the old one. That part is safe.

The part that is not obvious: the dashboard follows the newest run. So this button changes what every analyst is looking at, from a page labelled admin, with no confirmation and nothing telling them it happened.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip: There are five sources on the checklist above and this says 4/4. Either the macro calendar has no health check at all, or this panel predates it.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip: 'EDGAR lag' is the only place on this screen where the Cutoff is visible, and it is phrased as a warning rather than as 'yesterday's filings-derived signals were stale'.
